notes: Each causal מִן is written separately in the Hebrew and takes its own *because*; rule 25's distributed repetition is not in play.
The two infinitive constructs keep their supplied modal (*would keep*) while their suffixes take the subject pronouns under rule 18.
מִן → *out of* heads on *out* (rule 24); בֵּית and יַד each take a supplied *the* because their recta are rendered anarthrously (rule 29).
